exam.title: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: Azure Administrator Associate-level implementation knowledge plus advanced experience in networking, virtualization, identity, security, business continuity, disaster recovery, data platforms, governance, Azure development, and DevOps processes.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions

review.notes: All four weighted April 17, 2026 objective groups and their published subobjectives are mapped to an architecture decision method, trade-off tables, common failure modes, two integrated scenarios, eight independent design labs, and 24 original knowledge checks. All 29 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries; two O'Reilly pages and one Udemy page returned HTTP 403 to the automated monitor and are treated as access-blocked rather than missing. The guide explicitly separates architecture design from AZ-104 implementation detail and marks service tiers, limits, licensing, region/zone support, networking, pricing, and retirement-sensitive product behavior VERIFY CURRENT.

findings.title: Lower-cost log ingestion changes operational capabilities
findings.evidence: Basic Simple Log Alerts and Auxiliary/Lake alert/replication exclusions differ.
findings.recommendation: Add table-plan decision record and cost/query boundary.
findings.resolution: Add table-plan decision record and cost/query boundary.

findings.title: New vault RBAC defaults do not migrate existing access
findings.evidence: 2026-02-01 default applies to create; earlier control-plane APIs retire February 27, 2027.
findings.recommendation: Separate API upgrade from explicit access-model change.
findings.resolution: Separate API upgrade from explicit access-model change.

findings.title: Object backups have a constrained recovery boundary
findings.evidence: Same subscription/geography and per-object backup with version limit.
findings.recommendation: Add recovery prerequisites and avoid universal escape-path claim.
findings.resolution: Add recovery prerequisites and avoid universal escape-path claim.

findings.title: Database failover is not end-to-end workload recovery
findings.evidence: Listeners cover database routing; Microsoft recommends customer-managed recovery.
findings.recommendation: Add dependency/ownership and client recovery evidence.
findings.resolution: Add dependency/ownership and client recovery evidence.

findings.title: Namespace replication modes protect different state and availability
findings.evidence: Geo-Replication includes messages/state; one secondary, partition preview and large-message exclusions remain.
findings.recommendation: Compare modes, lag, promotion and duplicate handling.
findings.resolution: Compare modes, lag, promotion and duplicate handling.

findings.title: SDK retirement and SBMP usability have different effects
findings.evidence: September 30, 2026 SDKs unsupported while SBMP becomes unusable.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped migration and deadline follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add scoped migration and deadline follow-up.

findings.title: HTTP response deadlines differ from execution timeouts
findings.evidence: HTTP 230-second response cap; separate Linux v3 September 2026 and hosting 2028 deadlines.
findings.recommendation: Teach asynchronous result pattern and scoped runtime inventory.
findings.resolution: Teach asynchronous result pattern and scoped runtime inventory.

findings.title: Premium v2 is not full classic Premium feature parity
findings.evidence: Multi-region and automated classic upgrade unavailable; private backend integration not private inbound.
findings.recommendation: Add capability/network/recovery comparison with classic Premium.
findings.resolution: Add capability/network/recovery comparison with classic Premium.

findings.title: Replicated configuration is eventually consistent
findings.evidence: Replica endpoints and client/provider behavior matter for failover.
findings.recommendation: Add stale/default handling and avoid instant-global-revocation assumption.
findings.resolution: Add stale/default handling and avoid instant-global-revocation assumption.

findings.title: Redis retirement is tier-specific
findings.recommendation: Add migration inventory and cold-cache load exercise.
findings.resolution: Add migration inventory and cold-cache load exercise.

findings.title: Classic ingress requires a staged migration
findings.evidence: March 31, 2027 retirement and postmigration DNS update requirement.

findings.title: Default outbound change is scoped to new networks and API behavior
findings.evidence: New VNets private by default for APIs after March 31, 2026; existing networks unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit egress and service dependency checks.
findings.resolution: Add explicit egress and service dependency checks.
